'''Sky slicers''' were an innovative type of [[Swoop/Legends|swoop]] consisting of a flat elliptoid with [[micro-repulsorlift turbine]]s on the bottom surface. A popular urban environment sport, personal [[Skimmer/Legends|skimming]] with a sky slicer was called "sky slicing." Racers kept their balance with [[Magnetic boot/Legends|magboots]]. While not the fastest swoops, sky slicers were the most maneuverable. A low-frequency [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] generator mounted on the rear allowed for the towing of a passenger in an optional "[[drogue slicer]]," which was equipped for its own lift but no independent forward momentum.

A popular model was the [[Sky Striker 5000]].
